headline: Zichis Agro 9M Pre-Tax Profit Jumps 179% to N561 Million
summary: Zichis Agro-Allied Industries reported a 179.2% increase in pre-tax profit to N561.32 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. Revenue grew to N1.22 billion over the same period.
why: Zichis Agro-Allied Industries is an active player in West Africa's agricultural processing and supply chain sector.
